recognize_zh: 積液細胞塊中可見數團及散在的大型不典型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、核仁明顯，細胞互不黏著，背景是淡粉紅色蛋白質與纖維蛋白碎屑，沒有腺體結構，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Multiple loose clusters and single large atypical lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei with prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Discohesive arrangement without true cell junctions, glands or papillae
Admixed red blood cells within clusters
Pale eosinophilic proteinaceous and fibrinous background
describe_en: Cell block of effusion fluid shows several loose aggregates and scattered single large atypical lymphoid cells within a pale proteinaceous and fibrinous background. The cells have round to oval nuclei with prominent nucleoli and a moderate amount of amphophilic cytoplasm, and they lack cohesive epithelial architecture. Mesothelial sheets and gland formation are not identified. Findings are consistent with involvement of the effusion by a large cell lymphoma, and in the context of HHV8 LANA-1 positivity and a null or plasmablastic immunophenotype, with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin positive and CD45 negative.
It expresses CD20/CD79a and is negative for HHV8 LANA-1, whereas PEL typically lacks B-cell antigens and is LANA-1 positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD10+/BCL2- with MYC rearrangement.
